conventions.grammar_spec: Each grammar is a restriction of the published bundle seed-witness-v1. 'entries' lists published entry IDs (absent = all 178). 'clones' add an entry that keeps its source's recipe, ground category and meaning, with a new id and optionally new cost or tokens. 'rules', 'roots', 'max_tokens' default to the published values.
conventions.input: The JSON value passed as the sentence. Non-strings are deliberate.
conventions.max_edges: Present only when the request carries a budget.
conventions.expected: tokens, construction_status, decision, diagnostic {code[, token, index]}, readings (canonical set, byte order), min_cost, ranked_readings (display order by best witness), witnesses in rank order with cost, object_wide_uses, key (JSON arrays for the contract's tuples) and the reading each supports.
conventions.edge_count: My count of distinct edges in exact mode for inputs that pass lexical and length checks: packed bottom-up chart over all spans; node = (start, end, ground category); lexical edge = (start, end, entry ID); binary edge = (rule ID, left node, right node). Truncated iff edge_count > max_edges.
conventions.depends_on: Readings of points witness-v1.md leaves open. A mismatch on a case with a non-empty depends_on list may be a difference of convention rather than a defect.
